name: Empty
overview: Scripture warns against empty or vain practices, such as meaningless repetitions in prayer, which do not bring true communication with God as seen in Matthew 6:7. The Bible contrasts these empty actions with the genuine promise of eternal life through faith in Christ, highlighted in John 3:16. True guidance and truth come from the Spirit, who speaks not from Himself but reveals God's will (John 16:13), emphasizing that spiritual emptiness is filled only through a living relationship with Jesus rather than hollow words or empty promises.
